name: com.uni-tx.season-pass
description: Seasonal battle pass with free and paid reward tracks, monotonic XP, capped earn sources, quests, tier skips, retroactive unlocks, configurable expiry and a backend seam for server authority.

samples.description: The whole lifecycle in one script: earning capped XP, unlocking the paid track mid-season with a retroactive back-grant, buying tier skips, and forcing a rollover that archives progress while keeping what the player owns.

A uGUI track/tier/claim screen driven by the service's change event. Needs com.uni-tx.widgets and com.uni-tx.sprite-loader; without them the sample's assembly is skipped rather than breaking the project.
